data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Mabruk', which means 'to have achieved success' or 'to be blessed'. The name Mabrooka carries the meaning “Blessed, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
